rule.statement: A power of attorney granted by joint principals terminates upon the death of one of the principals.
rule.supporting_quote: The position that the death of one grantor would terminate a Power of Attorney granted is further confirmed by the aforementioned clause of the impugned Power of Attorney. As per the clause, it is evident that the power of the principals conferred to the agent is joint (as opposed to joint and several principals) as only acts conducted during the lifetime of both grantors have been authorized.
